file_insights.description: Created comprehensive CadenceDisplay component for showing cadence metrics
Added extensive test coverage for CadenceDisplay component with multiple scenarios

patterns_discovered: Accessibility-first design with detailed screen reader labels
Animated status indicators for out-of-range metrics
Flexible prop handling with optional target and tolerance
gotchas_discovered: Need to handle multiple states: no metrics, null cadence, with/without target
Animated warning indicators require careful state management

key_achievements: Added visual warning for out-of-target cadence

recommendations: Consider extracting status color and label logic into separate utility functions
Add prop-types or TypeScript validation for input parameters
Consider performance optimization for complex useMemo calculations
Expand animation configuration options in future iterations
